summary: Chor Ratchawat Muay Thai runs two Muay Thai gyms in Bo Phut and Plai Laem, Koh Samui, with group, private, kids and fighter programs and DTV visa document support.

facts.label: DTV
facts.value: Helps with documents for the DTV visa
facts.quote: We help you get the documents for the Thailand DTV visa, up to 180 days.

facts.label: Group training
facts.quote: Morning and afternoon sessions with pad work, bag work, clinching, and conditioning.

facts.label: Opening hours
facts.value: Open 6 days a week, 7 AM to 8 PM
facts.quote: Open 6 days a week from 7 AM to 8 PM.

facts.quote: with two locations in Bo Phut and Plai Laem
